主要内容: On March 19, 2018, Sangamo Therapeutics, Inc. approved the Amended and Restated Incentive Compensation Plan (Cash Incentive Plan). The plan, effective from June 21, 2012, provides cash incentives to employees based on performance objectives during designated periods. Performance periods occur annually, starting with 2018. Employees hired by October 31 are eligible. Executive officers, including Alexander Macrae (CEO), have target percentages of 60% and 35%, respectively. Bonuses are based on performance objectives, which may include revenue targets, development milestones, and financial metrics. Actual awards may not exceed 200% of the target unless approved by the Compensation Committee. The full plan will be filed with the Company’s Q1 2018 10-Q report.
